summary: Operator rates page: 30A $35, 50A $37 a night (+$5 per extra guest), monthly $325 + metered electric; 26 pull-through FHU 30/50A sites (stored 33 was wrong), open year round, phone booking. Google 4.4 over 78. Operator phone is (573) 308-6171, not the stored 573-458-9185.
flags: Price gate: $35 (30A) / $37 (50A) a night posted by the operator, read 2026-11-08; RV Life camper reports 2024 $29-37. Presence: own website with phone + Google 4.4 over 78 reviews; RV Life 4* over 22.
PHONE WRONG: stored 573-458-9185; the operator's site and Google both give (573) 308-6171 (apply.py does not write phones).

LONG-STAY (passes; occupancy unread): the rates page sells monthly at $325 plus metered electric, and it is 20 minutes from Fort Leonard Wood. RV Life 8/2024: 'We've been staying at Three Springs for a few months as my husband is a travel nurse'; 5/2023: 'We have friends who are full-timers at this park'. But three of the five newest RV Life reviews (3/2024, 5/2024, 6/2024) were overnight stops ('Good overnight stop', 'Good for quick overnight stop'). Five tests: (1) $35 pass; (2) nightly rate posted, booking by phone with no approval - pass; (3) no minimum - pass; (4) share of nightly sites can't be measured (no booking engine), reviewers find transient sites - pass on the evidence; (5) RV park - pass.
Reviews mixed but above the line: RV Life 6/2024 rated 6/10 ('good for an overnight stop but not longer unless you like a rustic, no nonsense place'); 5/2023 'Our site was not level'.
